name: Relic
description: A saint's finger in a tin case. Once, it steadies someone who is dying. Dread +1 when attuned or used.

name: Saint's Finger
description: A preserved finger in a reliquary. Once, it stabilizes a dying character. Dread +1 when attuned or used.

name: Black Mirror
description: A small mirror that shows a place you know. Something looks back. Dread +2 when attuned or used.

name: Grimoire
description: A book of rites whose pages change when no one is watching. Dread +2 when attuned or used.

name: Mourning Mask
description: A mask that lets you speak with the dead. They remember you. Dread +2 when attuned or used.

name: Bone Idol
description: A carved idol: +1 to one roll, once per scene. It wants offerings. Dread +2 when attuned or used.

name: Iron Bell
description: A bell that drives off a horror. It is heard for miles. Dread +2 when attuned or used.

name: Grave Candle
description: A candle whose light the dead avoid. It burns cold. Dread +1 when attuned or used.

name: Chained Book
description: Ask a question of something old. It asks one back. Dread +3 when attuned or used.

name: Reliquary
description: A heavy reliquary: +1 armor against the eldritch. Obvious and slow. Dread +2 when attuned or used.

name: Holy Book
description: A worn book of scripture and rites. It steadies the hand and the voice. Dread +1 when attuned or used.
